verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bolt.new runs a live Node.js/browser environment with terminal and browser console access while building (bolt-gh-2, bolt-gh-3), and code-view editing happens in that same running environment (bolt-docs-1, bolt-docs-25), separate from later 'publish' with public/private visibility settings (bolt-docs-13, bolt-docs-29). However, the pack never explicitly names a 'live preview' pane or shows a founder interacting with a rendered app before publishing, so the story is only indirectly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-browser live app preview feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation of interacting with that preview before publishing.
